subject: Dedicated capacity performance validation - post-call notes & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@finservco.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity performance validation - post-call notes & next steps

Hi Sara - thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align the dedicated capacity validation with the SLOs you described. Please reply with any corrections.

TL;DR (what you asked us to validate)
- Interactive streaming SLO: p95 first-byte latency < 250ms, steady-state per-token latency < 25ms for average responses (~512 tokens).
- Concurrency: support 20 concurrent interactive users at that SLO.
- Batch/generate throughput: ability to handle sustained bulk workloads for nightly jobs (~2k tokens/sec aggregate).
- Model: 16k-context open-model variant (you mentioned "FinGPT-16k" as the target).

What we'll run during the dedicated validation window
- Side-by-side benchmark on H100 vs A100 (same model, identical prompts) to measure: cold start/first-token latency, steady-state per-token latency (streaming), throughput (tokens/sec) at target concurrency, and p95/p99 latency curves.
- Load profile: mix of 70% interactive (avg 512 tokens), 30% batch (longer requests up to 2k tokens).
- KV/prefix caching enabled for interactive flows to reflect real usage.

Preliminary capacity/size asks from your side
- Approve an IP allowlist and test VPC peering window (we need ~2 hours of connectivity to run non-production tests).
- Provide a 1k-sample prompt set (we can anonymize) and a representative concurrency schedule (when peak occurs).
- Point of contact for procurement for any PO/contract items (cc Victor if you want us to loop procurement).

Who's owning what
- Redwood: Aditya Rao will run the perf harness and produce raw results; Rafael Mendes will coordinate the Dedicated infra (node selection, reserved throughput config); I'll own the test plan and communicate results/next steps to your team.

Proposed schedule
- Test window: Mon 22 Jun or Tue 23 Jun (pick one morning Pacific, ~3 hours).
- Deliverable: benchmark CSV + config snapshot + recommendation for a Reserved Capacity SKU and sizing (within 48 hours of run).

Next step: Sara, can you confirm preferred test date (22 or 23), share the prompt set, and confirm procurement contact?

Thanks - Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@finservco.com>

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity performance validation - post-call notes & next steps

Marissa, thanks for the clear recap - this matches what we discussed. We can do Mon 22 Jun in the morning (US Pacific). I'll upload the 1k prompt set to the shared drive link you provided by Friday.

Procurement contact: Victor Cheng (cc'd) will handle any PO/contract addendum - Victor, can you confirm the procurement timeline? Ideally we'd like the validation to run before finalizing reserved capacity numbers, but we can sign a short addendum if needed.

Also one clarification on SLOs: p95 first-byte < 250ms is the target for interactive; we can tolerate p99 spikes to ~600ms during brief autoscale events. Hope that's helpful for test thresholds.

Thanks - Sara
Sara Lopez
Head of AI Products, FinServCo

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Dedicated capacity performance validation - post-call notes & next steps

Thanks - quick technical note before the run. Based on similar workloads we've benchmarked internally:
- H100 baseline: expect ~1.8-2.2x throughput vs A100 on this model family for fwd-only generation (depends on kernel path and sequence length). That typically translates to fewer reserved GPUs for same throughput.
- For the interactive profile (avg 512 tokens, 20 concurrent): an initial conservative sizing is 4x H100s with reserved throughput set to cover ~350-400 tokens/sec steady-state. Equivalent on A100 would be roughly 7-8 GPUs.
- Cold-first-token latency is more sensitive to batching and KV cache warmup; we'll include a warmup phase in the test plan to approximate steady-state interactive behavior.

I'll prepare the perf harness config (concurrency, prompt mix, warmup) and share before Monday. Rafael - I'll need the exact Dedicated SKU names you'll provision so I can map perf counters to hardware.

-Aditya
Principal Inference Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@finservco.com>, Victor Cheng <victor.cheng@finservco.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity performance validation - test artifacts and scheduling

Hi all - following up with the agreed test artifacts and a couple of schedule confirmations. Attached are the initial perf CSV from our dry run and the config snapshot (attached as stubs here). These are from a small internal run that mirrors your profile; they're not the final customer run but should help set expectations.

Attachments: perf-harness-results.csv, config-snapshot.txt

Key callouts from the dry run
- H100 (4x) estimate: sustained ~380 tokens/sec with p95 steady-state per-token latency ~18-22ms; first-byte p95 ~180-220ms after warmup.
- A100 (8x) estimate: sustained ~170-200 tokens/sec with p95 steady-state per-token latency ~35-45ms; first-byte p95 ~300-380ms.
- Under the mixed load (70% interactive), the H100 config hit your p95 target comfortably at 20 concurrent users in our small-scale test.

Suggested next steps
1) Confirm Monday 22 Jun 09:00 PT as the dedicated validation window.
2) Sara to upload the prompt set to the shared drive by EOD Friday (per earlier).
3) Victor/Procurement: if you need a short addendum for a test window (non-production), let us know and Rafael will share the minimum contract metadata.

I'll run the full harness on Monday with Aditya and Rafael and share the CSV + recommendation within 48 hours.

Thanks - Marissa
Marissa Cole
